category.name: Social media
category.description: Read and publish posts, comments and videos on social platforms.

entries.name: Ayrshare
entries.free_tier: trial credits; no permanent free tier — paid plans required for production use
entries.desc_en: Unified API to post, schedule, and analyze content across 14+ social networks (X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.) with one API key.
entries.notes: Ayrshare itself holds the underlying per-platform app approvals, so agents avoid individually applying for X/Meta/TikTok developer access. Vendor confirms an MCP server for AI agents; exact endpoint URL not independently verified this session.

entries.name: Bluesky / AT Protocol
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <session/OAuth2 token> (legacy app passwords also supported)
entries.free_tier: free, no key needed for public reads; free account required for posting
entries.desc_en: Post, read, and moderate content on Bluesky via the open, self-hostable AT Protocol REST/XRPC API.
entries.notes: Decentralized protocol; official OAuth2 is replacing legacy app passwords as the recommended auth method.

entries.name: LinkedIn API
entries.free_tier: check pricing — most scopes require LinkedIn Partner Program approval
entries.desc_en: Sign users in and share basic posts via OAuth2/OpenID Connect; most other endpoints require partner approval.
entries.notes: LinkedIn API access is heavily gated; only a narrow self-serve subset (Sign In with LinkedIn/OpenID Connect, basic Share on LinkedIn) is available without applying to a partner program (Marketing, Sales, Talent, Learning solutions).

entries.name: Mastodon API
entries.free_tier: free, no central key; register an app per instance, no cost
entries.desc_en: Post statuses, read timelines, and manage accounts on any Mastodon instance via REST API.
entries.notes: Decentralized: each Mastodon instance is its own API endpoint; app registration is per-instance and free.

entries.name: Meta Graph API (Facebook, Instagram)
entries.auth_hint: access_token=<token> query param or Authorization: Bearer <token>
entries.free_tier: free, but most non-trivial read/write permissions require Meta App Review and business verification
entries.desc_en: Read and publish posts, manage Pages, and access Instagram business content via Meta's Graph API.
entries.notes: Most useful permissions (posting, Instagram content, insights) require Meta App Review; basic/dev-mode access is limited to admins/testers.

entries.name: Pinterest API
entries.free_tier: free tier: standard rate limits; higher limits/trial access require app review
entries.desc_en: Create pins and boards and read analytics data on Pinterest via REST API v5.

entries.name: Reddit API
entries.free_tier: free for non-commercial/personal use under Reddit Data API terms; commercial or high-volume use requires a paid Data API license
entries.desc_en: Read posts/comments and submit posts, comments, or votes on Reddit via OAuth2 REST API.
entries.notes: Since 2023, commercial/high-volume access requires a separate paid Reddit Data API agreement.

entries.name: TikTok API
entries.free_tier: free; requires app review for production access, sandbox mode available for testing
entries.desc_en: Post videos/drafts and query content on TikTok via the Content Posting and Display OAuth2 REST APIs.
entries.notes: Apps must pass TikTok's review process before production/unaudited-client-mode access is granted.

entries.name: X (Twitter) API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <App Bearer token or OAuth2 user token>
entries.free_tier: very limited free tier: write-only, ~500 posts/month, no meaningful read access; paid tiers (Basic $200/mo+) needed for real usage
entries.desc_en: Post, search, and read tweets and manage X (Twitter) content via REST API v2.
entries.notes: Free tier is write-only and extremely restricted; practical agent use (reading timelines/search) generally requires a paid API tier. Docs page returned HTTP 402 during this check, consistent with the paid-access posture.

entries.name: YouTube Data API
entries.auth_hint: key=<API_KEY> for public reads; Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token> for writes/private data
entries.free_tier: free tier: 10,000 quota units/day (extendable on request)
entries.desc_en: Search videos, manage playlists/comments, and upload videos to YouTube via REST API.
entries.notes: Daily quota shared across all calls; different operations cost different quota amounts (e.g. search is expensive).
